title: Christmas Spot differences
description: Welcome to Christmas Spot differences Puzzle Game! Celebrate the holiday season with this fun Christmas Spot the Differences game! Challenge your observation skills by finding the differences between two festive images. Each level comes with 3 helpful hints to guide you along the way. Can you spot them all and complete the levels in time? Enjoy the holiday-themed puzzles and get into the Christmas spirit!
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play
